description: Keeps the main thread thin: a non-docs CODE Edit/Write by the orchestrator warns-then-blocks (delegate to a subagent/Workflow instead). Docs (*.md/mdx/txt/rst, docs/) and subagent writes (agent_id present) are allowed. WARN first, BLOCK on repeat within ORCH_THIN_TTL_S (900s). Per-repo opt-out: agent_hooks.orchestrator_only:false in rig.yaml or RIG_ORCHESTRATOR_ONLY=0 (default ON). Escape hatch: ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK=1 + ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK_REASON='why'. on_error=open: delegation discipline, not a security boundary.
